notes.title: Patchnotes - 07.06.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, new Update :)

[list]
[*] This update unlocks the eastern forest! It is still work in progress and might break!
[*] Changes to the southern forest
[*] Improvements with the mushroom bomb
[*] Menus don't stay open when dying anymore
[*] Fixed an issue with endless lockpicks
[*] Visual changes in all areas
[*] Various fixes
[/list]

I am currently very busy, so updates are a little delayed. I will still read all feedback on the current version and update you as soon as possible!

Thats it for now
Hannes

notes.title: Playtest Patch 22.05.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, new patch :)

[list]
[*] Picking up an item for the first time will now only show a big popup and not the small popup
[*] Enemies now respect gravity
[*] You now remember the names of characters you have already talked to
[*] Changed some key bindings
[*] Can hopefully not break free from pushing rocks anymore 
[*] When learning a melody, you now only need to play the amount of notes in that melody, even if you are wrong
[*] You now auto-lock-on to the next enemy when the current one is defeated
[*] Fixed an issue with buying the southern forest map
[*] Fixed an issue with buying the village map
[*] Fixed an issue with lag spikes when starting an arena fight
[*] Fixed an issue with dialog endings being weird
[*] Fixed an issue with dialog menu UI
[*] Fixed an issue with ui elements staying selected after exiting a menu
[*] Fixed some issues with learning melodies
[/list]

That's it for now.
Cheers, Hannes

notes.title: Playtest Patch 14.05.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, tiny patch to iron out some issues :)

[list]
[*] Fixed transition between cellar and the tavern
[*] Hopefully fixed loading issues by introducing a more fixed loading screen
[*] Fixed issues with the dialog ui
[*] Fixed issues with being able to quit and restart while still in the intro area
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's healthbar would be empty upon respawning
[*] Fixed an issue with moving while not supposed to be moving
[*] Fixed an issue with duet options persisting between character interactions
[/list]

That's it for now.
Cheers, Hannes

notes.title: Playtest Patch 12.05.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
here is the next patch with a bunch of fixes and suggestions!

[list]
[*] Updated stamina & perfect combos
[*] Perfect combos don't use ANY stamina anymore
[*] Dodging is now also on A on controller
[*] Heavy attack is now also on X but needs to be held down
[*] Decreased Difficulty of first arena fight
[*] Added a highlight for unread dialog options
[*] Scene transition in the cellar now works
[*] Added a tutorial for healing
[*] Focusing now works by pressing the left stick/shift once
[*] Can't get stuck anymore when pushing stones back and forth
[*] Added some delay to UI events so you can't accidentally close a window by spamming
[*] Health does not reset anymore when changing scenes
[*] Fixed an issue with deleting multiple save slots
[*] Fixed an issue with music not stopping when changing scenes
[*] Fixed an issue with heavy attacks not using stamina
[*] Fixed some issues with the pillbugs
[*] Fixed an issue with dialog UI not deactivating 
[*] Changed melody minigame UI
[*] Added some missing walls in cellars
[/list]

That's it for now.
Cheers, Hannes

notes.title: Playtest Patch 09.05.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, new patch for the playtest!

[list]
[*] Added a new stamina system to fight spamming attacks
[*] Added perfect combos where players get rewarded for waiting a bit between attacks
[*] Reworked a lot of the tutorials & added more
[*] Can't equip a secondary weapon anymore when you haven't equipped a primary weapon
[*] Fixed issues with ui not being exclusive
[*] Fixed an issue where you could hold any item if it wasn't meant to be held
[*] Fixed an issue with arena gates being too slow
[*] Reworked enemy attack system - hopefully more dangerous and less buggy
[*] can't open any menu during start sequence 
[*] Shadows don't disappear anymore when an object fades out
[*] Added a bunch of missing colliders
[/list]

That's it for now.
Cheers, Hannes

notes.title: Playtest Patch 05.05.
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.1.1s Patch
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of missing walls
[*] Added some missing colliders
[*] Fixed some issues with the terrain
[*] Reworked strong attacks to not break the game anymore
[*] Fixed a few issues with rolling
[*] Can't walk anymore during great toad cutscene
[*] Changed color of notes to reflect xbox-controller colors
[*] When leaving a door, you now don't need to leave the interaction area to interact again
[*] Fixed a bug with respawning notes in the notebook 
[*] Fixed a bug with projectiles not despawning
[/list]

[b]Changed some things with the save system ! This update will brick all earlier saves ![/b]

That's it for now. 

Cheers, Hannes
